interface.signature: def countVertex(N: int, edges: list[tuple[int, int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: The number of nodes N is a positive integer between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).
The edges list contains exactly N-1 edges, forming a valid tree with N nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v) in edges consists of two distinct node identifiers between 1 and N (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(len(selected) for selected in all_possible_coverings(edges))
postconditions.description: The function returns the minimum number of nodes required to cover all edges, where a node covers all edges incident to it. The solution is optimal for the given tree structure.

postconditions.expression: all(any(u in selected or v in selected for u, v in edges) for selected in all_possible_coverings_with_size(return_value, edges))
postconditions.description: There exists at least one selection of exactly return_value nodes that covers all edges, meaning every edge has at least one endpoint in the selection.
